instruction: Referring to the plugin recommendations document, install just the productivity and text-to-speech extension from Chrome's extension marketplace.

expected: Speechify Text to Speech Voice Reader

metadata.explanation: Task requires installing productivity extension (Momentum) and text-to-speech extension (Speechify). Uses existing evaluator functions.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic correct: get_find_installed_extension_name (chrome.py:1438-1472) reads Chrome Preferences file from filesystem and extracts extension names from manifest, returns list of installed extension names

Metric parameter handling CORRECT: is_expected_installed_extensions (chrome.py:102-117) correctly receives 'expected' parameter as the rules dict (returned by get_rule framework call) and accesses expected['expected'] - no incorrect pattern like expected.get('rules')
Data flow correct: getter returns list[str] of extension names -> metric receives rules dict with 'expected' key containing list of required extension names -> subset comparison

Comparison logic semantically appropriate: subset checking (line 114) allows additional extensions while verifying both required extensions are installed, correctly matches instruction 'install just the productivity and text-to-speech extension'
Complete coverage: evaluator verifies both required extensions - Momentum (productivity) and Speechify Text to Speech Voice Reader (text-to-speech)
Expected values semantically correct: extension names 'Momentum' and 'Speechify Text to Speech Voice Reader' match official Chrome Web Store extension names as they appear in Chrome manifest

State accessibility correct: Chrome extensions are persisted to Preferences file on filesystem (~/.config/google-chrome/Default/Preferences), getter reads from file not UI state, no browser reopen needed

No postconfig needed: rule validator warning is false positive - extension installation state persists to filesystem (Chrome Preferences JSON file), getter reads from file system not UI, verification works without reopening any UI
validation.rule_validation_notes: Postconfig warning was false positive - Chrome extension state persists to Preferences file on filesystem, no UI reopening needed for verification
